title: Retry still impossible after an interrupted install: comfy install refuses the existing clone
description: Found live on Linux 2026-07-30 while verifying MPI-408, which IS fixed - this is the next sibling of the same hole. Step 0b (engine.js:344) removes a stale workspace only when it has NO .git, a guard written for a workspace killed during the clone. But the clone takes seconds and the dependency install takes minutes, so an interrupted setup almost always leaves a COMPLETE valid clone, which 0b keeps and comfy install then refuses: exit 1, "ComfyUI is already installed at the specified path", naming --restore. The common case falls through a guard designed for the rare one, and Retry stays permanently dead on Linux/macOS - only escape is deleting engine/ComfyUI_linux by hand (verified: after rm -rf, Retry proceeded). Fixed by passing --restore when the workspace is already a clone, the flag comfy-cli 1.13.0 names in its own error. Chosen over delete-and-re-clone because the clone is the cheap half and these are the machines least able to spare a re-download. Standing lesson: each step of _provisionUvEngine needs its own idempotency and they are not interchangeable - 0b deletes, 1 clears, 3 restores; fixing one proves nothing about the next. Landed in 1.3.0 at the user call since nothing is published; the MPI-408 changelog line was widened to name both leftovers rather than adding a second entry.

attention.reason: LIVE-VERIFIED on Linux 2026-07-31 via a controlled before/after; only engine.js differed between exit 1 and success.
